APPROACH CONSTRAINT (TASK-02 operative requirement; incorporate per PLAN-08):
Implement A* pathfinding algorithm in Python for a weighted grid. The grid is an NxM matrix where each cell contains a non-negative movement cost; a cost of -1 marks a cell as impassable. Movement is allowed in four cardinal directions (up, down, left, right), and moving into a cell incurs the cost of that cell. Use the Manhattan distance as the heuristic. The algorithm must return the shortest path as an ordered list of (row, col) coordinate tuples and the associated total path cost.
Test with a 10x10 grid containing walls and varying terrain costs. Verify the path cost is optimal by comparing against Dijkstra on the same grid.
